description: Helper functions and type definitions for attribute and team condition handling, including ID generation, type guards, and operator options in the context of attribute synchronization rules.

classes.name: ITeamConditionWithId
classes.description: Extended team condition with client-side ID for React keys.

classes.name: IAttributeConditionWithId
classes.description: Extended attribute condition with client-side ID for React keys.

methods.name: generateConditionId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for React keys using crypto.randomUUID().

methods.name: getDefaultTeamCondition
methods.description: Returns a default team condition object with a generated ID.

methods.name: getDefaultAttributeCondition
methods.description: Returns a default attribute condition object with a generated ID.

methods.name: isTeamCondition
methods.description: Type guard to check if a condition is a team condition based on its identifier.

methods.name: isAttributeCondition
methods.description: Type guard to check if a condition is an attribute condition based on its identifier.

methods.name: isArrayOperator
methods.description: Checks if an operator is an array-based operator (IN or NOT_IN).

methods.name: formatConditionValue
methods.description: Formats the condition value based on the operator, ensuring correct array or single value format.

methods.name: getTeamOperatorOptions
methods.description: Provides operator options for team conditions, localized via translation function.

methods.name: getOperatorOptionsForAttributeType
methods.description: Provides operator options based on attribute type, localized via translation function.

methods.name: getParentOperatorOptions
methods.description: Provides logical operator options (AND/OR) for rule composition.

methods.name: getConditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides condition type options (team or attribute) for selection.
